name: Smith Machine Overhead Press
cues: Stand under the bar with it at chin height
Grip just outside shoulder width and brace your core
Press up until your arms are straight
Lower back to chin height without arching your back

qa.note: Family review 2026-10-01 rated minor. review: Bar rides one vertical rail line slightly in front of the head, from chin height (elbow 142) to lockout (elbow 5, humerus 161 deg, in front). Head moves back as the bar passes the face. Hands closed on the bar. The whole tall Smith frame is in frame. The figure is small inside the tall frame, the same as the approved 407.
